title: Blade Ward
contents: text | You extend your hand and trace a sigil of warding in the air.
text | Until the end of your next turn, you have resistance against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks.

title: Chill Touch
contents: text | You create a ghostly, skeletal hand in the space of a creature within range.
text | Make a ranged spell attack. On hit, the target takes 1d8 necrotic damage and can’t regain hit points until the start of your next turn.
text | If the target is undead, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against you until the end of your next turn.

title: Eldritch Blast
contents: text | A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature.
text | Make a ranged spell attack. On hit, the target takes 1d10 force damage.
text | The spell creates more than one beam at higher levels: two at 5th, three at 11th, and four at 17th.
text | You can direct the beams at the same target or at different ones.

title: Friends
contents: text | ComponentsS, M (a small amount of makeup)
text | For the duration, you have advantage on all Charisma checks directed at one creature of your choice that isn’t hostile toward you.
text | When the spell ends, the creature realizes you used magic to influence its mood and may become hostile.

title: Mage Hand
contents: text | A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range.
text | The hand lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action.
text | It can manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve items, or pour contents.
text | It can’t attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

title: Mind Sliver
contents: text | You drive a disorienting spike of psychic energy into the mind of one creature you can see.
text | The target must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or take 1d6 psychic damage,
text | and subtract 1d4 from the next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn.

title: Minor Illusion
contents: text | You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration.
text | The illusion ends early if you dismiss it or cast this spell again.
text | If a creature uses its action to examine the illusion, it can determine it’s fake with a successful Investigation check against your spell save DC.

title: Poison Spray
contents: text | You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a puff of noxious gas.
text | The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d12 poison damage.

title: Prestidigitation
contents: text | You perform minor magical tricks: light a candle, clean an object, chill or warm food, color an item, mark a surface, or create a sensory effect.
text | You can have up to three effects active at once. Recasting ends an old effect.

title: Thunderclap
contents: text | You create a burst of thunderous sound audible up to 100 feet.
text | Each creature other than you within 5 feet must make a Constitution saving throw.
text | On a failed save, a creature takes 1d6 thunder damage.

title: Toll the Dead
contents: text | You point at one creature you can see within range, and the sound of a dolorous bell fills the air around it.
text | The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d8 necrotic damage.
text | If the target is missing any of its hit points, it instead takes 1d12 necrotic damage.

title: True Strike
contents: text | You extend your hand and gain insight into the target’s defenses.
text | On your next turn, you gain advantage on your first attack roll against the target, provided the spell hasn’t ended.
